title: Workflows and Solution Design
description: Defining success first, what to hand Claude, what to escalate, and the limits stakeholders should know.

cards.definition: A sandboxed capability that lets Claude build and edit Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PDF files and analyze data in a chat; it counts against usage.
Claude can turn one file type into another, for example a Word document into a presentation, when file creation is enabled.
Artifacts can be exported in standard formats, for example docs to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs and slides to PowerPoint or PDF.
Before building a workflow or tuning prompts, define what a good result looks like and how you will test it; otherwise you cannot tell whether changes help.
Hand Claude jobs like building a budget spreadsheet, turning a CSV into a report, converting a Word document to slides, or pulling PDF tables into Excel, then review the result.
File work has caps: 30MB per file, limited task and sandbox duration, and heavier use of your usage limits than ordinary chat, so size workflows accordingly.
On Team and Enterprise, owners decide whether file creation and its network access are on; the safe default is access off, adding only vetted domains.
Building or hosting a remote MCP server is technical work to hand to IT; you then add the finished server under Customize > Connectors.
A custom connector's server must accept connections from Anthropic's cloud, so one on a private network needs Anthropic allowlisted in its firewall.
For repeatable processes, write a specific description so Claude knows when to use the skill, keep one purpose per skill, and test it with varied prompts after uploading.
On Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise plans, Settings > Usage shows your session and weekly limits, so you can judge whether a workflow fits.
Archiving a project clears the list but keeps its sharing settings and knowledge, and you must unarchive it before you can delete it.
A project's name and description are not seen by Claude, so they only help you organize; anything Claude should know belongs in instructions or knowledge.
Research can use limits faster than normal chat because it pulls many sources, and it cannot use tools from local MCP servers set up in Claude Desktop.
In the mobile app, Research searches only the web and silently skips your connectors, so start it on the web or in Desktop when internal sources matter.
A paid-plan mode where Claude plans and carries out multi-step file and research tasks, on desktop and in the cloud, instead of answering one prompt at a time.
